title: Two horizontal principal Cech differentials compose to zero
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\in\mathbb N$, $f:\operatorname{Fin}r\to A$, and $F$ an integer-indexed complex of module sheaves on $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total]. For every integer $p$, the explicitly constructed alternating restriction maps of [def-sc-principal-cech-columns] satisfy $h_p(F)\,;\,h_{p+1}(F)=0$ as maps of $A$-module complexes. No boundedness or quasi-coherence assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 01FP (Section 20.25), total cochains and restriction differential; perfect.tex, Tag 08D1, alternating double complex and signs

proof.text: Project to a subset S in horizontal degree p+2 and evaluate at a coefficient degree. Expand both sums using product projection identities. Each surviving term is indexed by an ordered pair of distinct deleted members a,b of S.

Pair (a,b) with (b,a). Presheaf functoriality identifies both composites with restriction from S minus {a,b} to S. For a<b, deleting a reduces the position of b by one, while deleting b leaves the position of a unchanged. Consequently the exponents differ by one and the signs are opposite. Empty twice-deleted subsets are omitted in both orders.

The involution reversing deletion order has no fixed point. Cancel the paired terms. Product projections and degree evaluations detect equality, proving h_p followed by h_(p+1) is zero. Negative or absent rows have empty index types and require no extra hypothesis.

lean.statement: theorem principalCechHorizontal_square (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (p : ℤ) : (principalCechHorizontal r f p).app F ≫ (principalCechHorizontal r f (p + 1)).app F = 0
